AccessRoute.description:
How authenticated authority reached the application.

Local and hosted entry paths both resolve to one of these routes and share the same
authorization rules; no route is granted authority because the connection is loopback.

oneOf.description: Hosted Explorer session established through WorkOS AuthKit.
External agent: a WorkOS Connect token when hosted, a local connector credential when local.
The installation-local owner identity, authenticated through the local browser session.

DelegationCeiling.description: Upper bound on what a delegated client may do; it only narrows grants, never adds to them.

permissions.description: Capabilities the delegation may exercise; effective permission is the intersection with grants.

workspace_ids.description: Workspaces the delegation is limited to; absent means no restriction beyond the delegator's grants.

Permission.description: Application capabilities checked on every operation.

oneOf.description: Create or update proposals without merging.

Principal.description:
Server-established identity; never accepted from a request body.

Identity is not authorization: effective permissions come from the access-control adapter
as workspace and tenant grants, intersected with any delegation ceiling.

client_id.description: OAuth client when delegation is present.

tenant_id.description: Tenant boundary every storage scope for this principal carries.

WorkspaceId.description: Stable application identity for one user-organized workspace.

description: Current identity and capability summary without credentials.

csrf_required.description: Browser writes require a same-origin anti-CSRF token.
